title: Preference Shocks and Policy Responses to Transition Risk
title_zh: DP21772 偏好冲击与转型风险的政策应对
authors: Stefano Carattini, Givi Melkadze, Inès Mourelon
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Central banks and financial surveillance authorities need to cope with the potential realization of financial stability risks, adopting preventive measures or using liquidity once crises materialize. Transition risk — the stability risk associated with decarbonization — is a case in point. Such risk not only comes from policy changes, but also from preference shocks. Hence, this paper develops an environmental DSGE model with financial frictions and examines responses to shocks, including a novel angle on preference shocks. We show that these market-driven transition shocks generate larger macro financial instability than carbon pricing for a given change in emissions, while delaying environmental gains. We then compare policy responses according to their timing. Ex-ante macroprudential policies that reduce banks’ exposure to transition risk dampen financial amplification, whereas ex-post interventions, such as quantitative easing, provide only partial stabilization once losses have materialized. Overall, our results indicate that market-led adjustments to transition risk are more destabilizing than carbon pricing, whereas preventive financial measures limit macro-financial instability more effectively than ex-post interventions under the policy comparisons considered, supporting the case for early action.
abstract_zh: 中央银行和金融监管当局需要应对金融稳定风险可能实现的情况，在危机发生时采取预防性措施或动用流动性。转型风险——与脱碳相关的稳定性风险——就是一个典型例子。此类风险不仅源于政策变化，还来自偏好冲击。为此，本文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的环境动态随机一般均衡模型，并从偏好冲击这一新颖视角考察了各冲击的响应。研究表明，在给定排放变化条件下，这些市场驱动的转型冲击比碳定价引发更大的宏观金融不稳定，同时延迟环境效益的实现。随后，我们根据政策实施时机比较了不同政策应对措施。事前宏观审慎政策通过降低银行对转型风险的敞口来抑制金融放大效应，而事后干预措施（如量化宽松）在损失发生后仅能提供部分稳定效果。总体而言，我们的结果表明，市场主导的转型风险调整比碳定价更具不稳定性，而在所考虑的政策比较中，预防性金融措施比事后干预更能有效限制宏观金融不稳定，这为尽早采取行动提供了支持依据。

title: DP149 Unemployment and Female Labour Supply
title_zh: DP149 失业与女性劳动力供给
authors: Richard Blundell, Costas Meghir, John Ham, Serdar Birinci, Loukas Karabarbounis 等
official: 官方在线 1987-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper is an attempt to gauge how much the conclusions derived from the standard analysis of labour supply may have to be altered when we allow for such 'unemployed' workers. For the sample of married women in the UK which we investigate, the standard model appears to exaggerate the positive impact which reductions in marginal wages may have on participation and reduces the possibilities for a backward-bending supply curve of labour. The probability of being in a state of unemployment, as defined above, is found to depend on certain demand-side factors, age and a number of other demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估，当我们将此类“失业”工人纳入考量时，标准劳动供给分析所得结论可能需要做出多大程度的修正。基于我们所研究的英国已婚女性样本，标准模型似乎夸大了边际工资下降对劳动参与率的正向影响，并降低了劳动供给曲线向后弯曲的可能性。研究发现，处于上述定义的失业状态的概率取决于某些需求侧因素、年龄以及其他若干人口特征。

title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件揭示的股市信念过度反应
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Sydney C Ludvigson, Sai Ma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks. (JEL E7, E27, E32, E17, G4)
abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合，量化了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。研究发现，投资者系统性地对多重基本面冲击的感知过度反应，这一现象通常通过“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应表明，即使投资者对所有冲击均过度反应，股票市场仍可能对新闻反应不足。（JEL分类号：E7, E27, E32, E17, G4）

title: The Green Revolution and individualism: Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 绿色革命与个人主义：来自印度尼西亚的证据
authors: Yeonha Jung, Uyseok Lee, Gedeon Lim
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。

title: Quantitative Easing and Government Debt Sustainability
title_zh: 量化宽松与政府债务可持续性
authors: Wenhao Li, Sebastian A. Merkel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that quantitative easing (QE) worsens government debt sustainability. In our model, the government has a negative primary balance and downward-sloping debt demand that makes interest rates endogenous. The central bank has long-term capital and remits profits to the fiscal authority. QE depletes this capital stock, reducing future remittances and crisis-fighting reserves. Contrary to Sargent and Wallace (1981), where greater monetary accommodation lowers the steady-state debt level, we show that QE increases the steady-state level of debt and shifts the default boundary inward, thus heightening fragility and reducing debt sustainability. Moreover, while QE can keep interest rates low for extended periods, sustaining a QE-backed rate peg requires a growing central-bank footprint and accelerating capital depletion, until financing costs rise sharply. Under certain parameters, large-scale QE makes previously sustainable debt levels unsustainable, leading ultimately to sovereign default.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，量化宽松（QE）会恶化政府债务可持续性。在我们的模型中，政府存在负的初级财政余额和向下倾斜的债务需求曲线，这使得利率具有内生性。央行持有长期资本，并将利润上缴给财政部门。量化宽松消耗了这部分资本存量，减少了未来的上缴利润和应对危机的储备。与Sargent和Wallace（1981）的结论——即更大的货币宽松程度会降低稳态债务水平——相反，我们证明量化宽松提高了稳态债务水平，并将违约边界向内推移，从而加剧了脆弱性并降低了债务可持续性。此外，尽管量化宽松能在较长时间内维持低利率，但维持量化宽松支撑的利率盯住政策需要央行资产负债表持续扩张和资本加速消耗，直至融资成本急剧上升。在特定参数条件下，大规模量化宽松会使原本可持续的债务水平变得不可持续，最终导致主权违约。

title: Fusing Data Sources to Measure Multidimensional Poverty
title_zh: 融合数据源以测度多维贫困
authors: Brunckhorst, Ben J., Nguyen, Minh C., Yonzan, Nishant, Dang, Hai-Anh, Lakner, Christoph
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Multidimensional poverty metrics offer a more complete picture of poverty than monetary poverty, yet their adoption has been limited by data constraints. Often not all dimensions in a multidimensional measure are observed in the same survey, leading to countries being excluded from global measures. This study introduces a novel data fusion approach to estimate multidimensional poverty metrics by combining summary statistics from multiple data sources. The proposed method is validated by simulating typical missing data scenarios using 571 household surveys from 112 countries (1989–2024) to estimate the World Bank’s Multidimensional Poverty Measure. The fusion method accurately predicts various multidimensional poverty metrics across these scenarios, even in the presence of simulated sample bias reflecting differences in survey design. It enables estimates of multidimensional poverty for a greater number of countries, gap-filling in time series, and the inclusion of previously unavailable indicators and dimensions in global multidimensional poverty measures.
abstract_zh: 多维贫困指标相比货币贫困能更全面地反映贫困状况，但其应用受限于数据约束。由于多维贫困指标中的各个维度往往无法在同一项调查中完整观测，导致许多国家被排除在全球性贫困测度之外。本研究提出一种创新的数据融合方法，通过整合多个数据源的汇总统计量来估算多维贫困指标。该方法利用112个国家（1989-2024年）的571项家庭调查数据，通过模拟典型数据缺失场景对世界银行多维贫困测度进行验证。结果表明，即便在存在反映调查设计差异的模拟样本偏差时，该融合方法仍能准确预测各类多维贫困指标。该方法不仅能够为更多国家提供多维贫困估算，填补时间序列数据缺口，还能将此前无法获取的指标和维度纳入全球多维贫困测度体系。

title: The Female Sensitivity Hypothesis: Evidence From Experimental Economics
title_zh: 女性敏感性假说：来自实验经济学的证据
authors: Felipe Araujo, Neeraja Gupta, Lise Vesterlund
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We assess the empirical evidence for the hypothesis that women more than men respond to changes in treatment. First, we examine whether the results of over two hundred experimental economics papers support the female sensitivity hypothesis. Second, using data from two studies (DellaVigna and Pope, 2022; Exley et al., 2025), we conduct over two hundred pairwise tests of the hypothesis. Both analyses show that gender is not predictive of responsiveness to treatment. We further examine how the hypothesis has been disseminated in the literature and find that it is referenced predominantly by papers that support it.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了女性比男性更易对处理变化做出反应这一假设的实证证据。首先，我们考察了超过两百篇实验经济学论文的结果是否支持女性敏感性假说。其次，利用两项研究（DellaVigna和Pope，2022；Exley等，2025）的数据，我们对该假说进行了超过两百次成对检验。两项分析均表明，性别并不能预测对处理的反应程度。我们进一步考察了该假说在文献中的传播情况，发现其主要被支持该假说的论文所引用。

title: Federal Research Funding and STEM Education
title_zh: 联邦科研经费与STEM教育
authors: Cook, Emily E., Ghose, Devaki, Khmelnitskaya, Ekaterina
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract_zh: 本文考察了联邦科学与工程研究资助——尽管其初衷是推动研究——如何影响科学、技术、工程和数学领域的学位产出与项目设置。基于1971年至2016年的数据，本研究采用三重差分设计，利用学院、时间和学科领域的差异进行分析。结果显示，在美国200所研究型大学中，联邦资助每年贡献了27.4%的博士学位、14.7%的本科STEM学位，以及6.3%的博士项目和3.7%的本科STEM项目。这些影响主要集中在生物学和工程学领域，与卫生与公众服务部、国家科学基金会和国防部等主要资助方的优先方向一致。研究结果表明，对大学的研究资助可能产生“双重红利”，在推动科学发现的同时，也扩大了目标领域熟练劳动力的供给。

title: Competition in a Spatially-Differentiated Product Market with Negotiated Prices
title_zh: 谈判价格下的空间差异化产品市场竞争
authors: Walter Beckert, Howard Smith, Yuya Takahashi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。

title: Industrial Relations and Working from Home in Germany during the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: 新冠疫情期间德国的劳资关系与居家办公
authors: Laszlo Goerke, Yue Huang, Viola Hilbert, Markus M. Grabka
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the role of industrial relations for working from home during and after the COVID- 19 pandemic in Germany. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) for the years 2020 to 2023 and a special COVID sample (SOEP-CoV) for 2020 and 2021, we examine how collec- tive bargaining and plant-level co-determination are associated with the incidence and frequency of working from home. Controlling for worker, firm, occupation, and industry characteristics, we find that employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement are less likely to work from home and do so less frequently than uncovered employees. In contrast, the incidence and frequency of working from home are positively associated with the presence of a works council.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了新冠疫情期间及之后德国劳资关系对居家办公的影响。利用2020至2023年德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP）及2020至2021年新冠专项样本（SOEP-CoV），我们考察了集体谈判与工厂层面共同决策机制如何影响居家办公的发生率与频率。在控制劳动者、企业、职业及行业特征后，研究发现：受集体谈判协议覆盖的员工居家办公可能性更低且频率更少，而企业职工委员会的存在则与居家办公的发生率及频率呈正相关。

title: An Experimental Comparison of Cap- and Intensity-based Pollution Markets
title_zh: 基于总量与强度的污染市场实验比较
authors: Friesen, Lana, MacKenzie, Ian, Shen, Peiyao, MacKenzie, Ian A.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Markets are an increasingly popular regulatory choice to cost effectively control negative externalities. Traditionally, market designs have employed a cap-and-trade format that places an absolute limit on the quantity of emissions. In contrast, many new schemes—including the world’s largest in China—limit the aggregate emissions intensity of production. This article theoretically and experimentally compares intensity- and capbased markets. We design a novel laboratory experiment, where firms choose both output and allowance exchange. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, we find that employing an intensity-based market rather than an equivalent cap-and-trade scheme significantly increases aggregate output, average allowance prices, aggregate abatement, and decreases industry profits. Overall, both markets perform as expected and close to the cost effective allocation of pollution abatement but with lower levels of aggregate profit as high production costs types produce significantly more output than predicted.
abstract_zh: 市场正日益成为以成本效益方式控制负外部性的流行监管选择。传统市场设计采用总量控制与交易模式，对排放总量设定绝对上限。相比之下，包括全球最大碳市场（中国）在内的许多新机制，则对生产过程中的总排放强度进行限制。本文通过理论与实验方法，对强度型市场与总量型市场进行了比较研究。我们设计了一项新颖的实验室实验，其中企业需同时选择产出水平与配额交易。与理论预测一致，研究发现：采用强度型市场相较于等效的总量控制与交易机制，会显著提高总产出、平均配额价格、总减排量，并降低行业利润。总体而言，两种市场均按预期运行，接近污染减排的成本有效分配，但由于高生产成本类型企业的实际产出显著高于理论预测，行业总利润水平有所下降。

title: Long Wars
title_zh: 长期战争
authors: Sandeep Baliga, Tomas Sjöström
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether the Coase conjecture holds for bargaining during war. Two players, A and B, contest a divisible resource until one side collapses or agreement is reached. If player B is militarily strong, then he insists on getting a large share. However, player A only concedes this large share if player B credibly signals his strength by fighting a sufficiently long war. Thus, the Coase conjecture fails, and asymmetric information about military strength explains why long wars may be inevitable. Using a mechanism design approach, we derive a lower bound on the expected duration of war. (JEL C78, D74, D82, F51)
abstract_zh: 我们研究科斯猜想在战争期间的讨价还价中是否成立。两名参与者A和B争夺一种可分割资源，直至一方崩溃或达成协议。如果参与者B在军事上强大，他会坚持要求获得较大份额。然而，只有当参与者B通过进行足够长时间的战争来可信地传递其军事实力信号时，参与者A才会让出这一较大份额。因此，科斯猜想不成立，关于军事实力的信息不对称解释了为何长期战争可能不可避免。通过机制设计方法，我们推导出战争预期持续时间的下限。（JEL C78, D74, D82, F51）

title: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
title_zh: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据
authors: Erin Kelley, Gregory Lane, Matthew Pecenco, Edward M. Rubin
official: 聚合元数据日期 2024-09-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50 percent fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
abstract_zh: 许多工人的工作表现取决于其与客户互动的能力。本研究衡量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲地区在线销售代理生产率的影响。通过采用一种新颖的实验框架——在不改变工人实际行为的前提下，随机向客户展示不同性别的姓名——我们发现，使用女性化姓名会导致购买量减少50%。客户不仅回复延迟、表达更不积极，还会回避讨论购买事宜。全球范围内的客户及不同工人群体均呈现类似结果。若消除客户偏见，女性工人的生产率将高于其男性同事。
